episodes.title: Big Brother
episodes.summary: Del gives Rodney a job with Trotters Independent Traders.

episodes.title: Go West Young Man
episodes.summary: Del sells a faulty car to an Australian man, and then believe that he and Rodney deserve a night out.

episodes.title: Cash and Curry
episodes.summary: Del finds himself as the peacekeeper bewteen two warring Indian businessmen.

episodes.title: The Second Time Around
episodes.summary: Del rekindles his friendship with an old fiancee of his, much to Rodney and Grandad's horror.

episodes.title: A Slow Bus to Chingford
episodes.summary: Del gets his hands on a double-decker bus and decides to start his own tour company.

episodes.title: The Russians Are Coming
episodes.summary: Fearing that a war is coming, Rodney and Grandad persuade Del to build a nuclear war shelter.

episodes.title: The Long Legs of the Law
episodes.summary: Rodney brings shame upon the Trotter family name when he begins dating a policewoman.

episodes.title: Ashes to Ashes
episodes.summary: Del and Rodney try to get rid of Trigger's grandad's ashes.

episodes.title: A Losing Streak
episodes.summary: Del plays a high stakes game of poker with Boycie.

episodes.title: No Greater Love...
episodes.summary: Rodney dates an older woman, even though her abusive ex-husband is about to be released from prison.

episodes.title: The Yellow Peril
episodes.summary: The Trotters get a job at painting a Chinese restaurant, which doesn't quite go according to plan...

episodes.title: It Never Rains...
episodes.summary: The Trotters go on a holiday to Spain, but something is not right with Grandad...

episodes.title: A Touch of Glass
episodes.summary: The Trotters are hired to clean some priceless chandeliers in a country mansion.

episodes.title: Homesick
episodes.summary: Rodney is appointed chairman of the local Tenants Association, and Del expects him to use his influence to secure a move to a council bungalow.

episodes.title: Healthy Competition
episodes.summary: Rodney leaves Trotters Independent Traders to go into business with Mickey Pearce.

episodes.title: Friday the 14th
episodes.summary: The Trotters head down south to illegally catch some salmon. But they've got more to worry about... there's an escaped axe-murderer on the loose!

episodes.title: Yesterday Never Comes
episodes.summary: Del goes out with an antiques dealer, who secretly wants to pilfer a painting off of him.

episodes.title: May the Force Be with You
episodes.summary: Del's old school enemy, Roy Slater, returns to Peckham.

episodes.title: Wanted
episodes.summary: Rodney goes on the run after being dubbed "The Peckham Pouncer".

episodes.title: Who's a Pretty Boy?
episodes.summary: Del persuades Denzil to let him decorate his flat, despite his wife Corrine's objections.

episodes.title: Happy Returns
episodes.summary: Shocking family secrets of the Trotters come to light when Rodney begins dating the daughter of one of Del's ex-fiancees.

episodes.title: Strained Relations
episodes.summary: At Grandad's funeral, Del and Rodney meet his long-lost brother, their Uncle Albert.

episodes.title: Hole in One
episodes.summary: Del sues the Brewery when Uncle Albert falls down The Nag's Head's cellar.

episodes.title: It's Only Rock and Roll
episodes.summary: Rodney joins an aspiring rock band, and Del becomes their manager.

episodes.title: Sleeping Dogs Lie
episodes.summary: Del and Rodney babysit Boycie and Marlene's new dog, Duke.

episodes.title: Watching the Girls Go By
episodes.summary: With some help from Del, Rodney tries to find a date for an upcoming party in order to win a bet against Mickey Pearce.

episodes.title: As One Door Closes
episodes.summary: The Trotters hunt for a rare butterfly.

episodes.title: From Prussia with Love
episodes.summary: The Trotters meet a pregnant German girl and allow her to stay at the flat.

episodes.title: The Miracle of Peckham
episodes.summary: Del witnesses a miracle at his local church, which creates a media frenzy.

episodes.title: The Longest Night
episodes.summary: The Trotters are held hostage inside the manager's office of a supermarket by "The Shadow".

episodes.title: Tea for Three
episodes.summary: Del and Rodney battle for the affections of Trigger's niece Lisa.

episodes.title: Video Nasty
episodes.summary: Rodney receives a grant to make a local film, but Del sees it as another opportunity to make money.

episodes.title: Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?
episodes.summary: Del's old friend Jumbo Mills returns to Peckham and asks him to help run his car business in Australia.

episodes.title: Yuppy Love
episodes.summary: Del adopts a new yuppy image, and Rodney meets Cassandra at an evening class.

episodes.title: Danger UXD
episodes.summary: Del acquires a batch of inflatable sex dolls.

episodes.title: Chain Gang
episodes.summary: Del and friends buy a set of 18 carat gold chains from a retired jeweller.

episodes.title: The Unlucky Winner Is...
episodes.summary: Del enters one of Rodney's paintings he did as a child into a competition. It wins Rodney and Cassandra a holiday to Spain. However, Del's coming too... and not as Rodney's brother.

episodes.title: Sickness & Wealth
episodes.summary: Del is suffering from stomach cramps, and refuses to see a doctor. But a séance by Elsie Partridge helps change his mind.

episodes.title: Little Problems
episodes.summary: With Rodney getting married, and the Driscoll Brothers demanding their money, Del is left with a difficult decision to make.

episodes.title: The Sky's the Limit
episodes.summary: Del acquires a satellite dish for Boycie, and Rodney goes to pick Cassandra up from Gatwick Airport, only to discover that her flight's been rerouted to Manchester. Could there be a link connecting the two events?

episodes.title: The Chance of a Lunchtime
episodes.summary: Del gets his hand on national anthem doorbells, Raquel auditions for a role in a Shakespeare play, and Rodney tries to repair his broken relationship with Cassandra.

episodes.title: Stage Fright
episodes.summary: Del arranges for Raquel and a club singer named Tony Angelino to perform a duet at The Starlight Rooms.

episodes.title: The Class of '62
episodes.summary: Del, Rodney, Boycie, Denzil, and Trigger attend a school reunion, but things turn ugly when an old schoolmate turns up...

episodes.title: He Ain't Heavy, He's My Uncle
episodes.summary: Crime is affecting the tenants of Nelson Mandela House, and when Uncle Albert becomes one of the victims, Del decides to take the law into his own hands...

episodes.title: Three Men, a Woman, and a Baby
episodes.summary: The birth of Del and Raquel's baby is imminent.
